verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so creating pull requests on hosted Git platforms from the device is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions git, a GitHub/GitLab CLI, or any pull-request workflow. Generic package installation via pkg and pip is only a building block, not documented support for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create pull requests on hosted Git platforms directly from my device
